title: the-claim-rides-every-link
intention: On a claimed chain the claim rides every link: a chart follower door refuses a claimless packet whose referenced berth claims a ticket, naming the upstream claim and the one-field fix in the same one-pass refusal — the claim may enter mid-chain, it may never silently vanish.
why: Voyage 3's own live fire measured the dormancy: its chain carried claims only at orient and validate, because the /chart skill's CARRY-THE-CLAIM line is prose nothing forces — so the interior mismatch check has no jurisdiction exactly where the post-compact splice lives. Akien ruled the shape at the gate (verdict on finding cbbadb13530f, 2026-08-03): 'no warns, refuse and send back to sender' — a warn disappears silently (Law 7), and auto-inherit fails the two-witness argument: a door-copied claim can never disagree with the berth it was copied from, so inheritance makes the check vacuous where the splice lives.
traces_to: Law 4 — the CARRY-THE-CLAIM prose becomes the door's own refusal
Law 7 — refuse loud and recoverable, never warn (Akien's verdict on cbbadb13530f)
ticket berths-carry-request-identity — the closed record's named candidate clause

what_a_year_later_reader_should_know: the shape was RULED, not chosen: Akien's verdict on finding cbbadb13530f killed the warn ('WARNs disappear silently... it should go back to whomever sent it') — the refusal names the upstream claim and the one-field fix, and writes nothing

auto-inherit died to the two-witness argument: the author's claim is the only side the berth cannot contaminate; a door-copied claim can never disagree with its source, so inheritance would make the identity check vacuous exactly where the splice lives

single-link jurisdiction propagates end-to-end because the chain is linear: refusing vanish while allowing ENTER means one orient claim forces the ride to validate with no chain-walk at any door — and the unclaimed world stays bit-unmoved (the retro-safe scoping of berths-carry-request-identity survives intact)

the vanish clause is ONE branch in identity_lack (orient.py, the shared home) — zero caller edits across the six followers, confirmed by diff; the tooth at test_chart_orient.py that pinned claimless-over-claimed as None was INVERTED, and a revert spot-check proved the new teeth bite

this voyage's own chart chain was the FIRST fully-claimed one (voyage 3's live fire had measured claims at orient+validate only) — the dormancy was closed by the same instrument that found it, same day
